# atlassian_confluence_space_permission_assignments (Data Source)

Reads every legacy permission assignment for one Confluence space. The result is an unordered set and includes Custom access, role-expanded permissions, and access-class principals returned by the API.

## Required OAuth scopes

- `read:space:confluence`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_confluence_space_permission_assignments" "example" {
  space_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) Numeric-string ID of the space.

### Read-Only

- `assignments` (Attributes Set) Complete permission assignments returned for the space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
